_comment: EXAMPLE — the shape of the fleet's Intune spec, with neutral placeholders. This repository is public: the installation's real spec (ids, hosts, serial numbers, owner) lives in the estate's PRIVATE configuration repository and is checked there by the reusable workflow intune-drift-check.yml. Field reference: deploy/macos/intune/README.md.

scripts.description: MeshWeaver.Deploy deploy/macos/intune/fleet-loader.sh (the STABLE loader) pinned at <commit>, with the bootstrap embedded as its fallback. Each run reads BootstrapCommit + BootstrapSha256 from the com.memex.local profile, fetches that bootstrap, verifies it and runs it. Runs as root, hourly; logs /Library/Logs/MeshWeaver/fleet-loader.log and fleet-bootstrap.log.

customProfiles.description: com.memex.local fleet keys for the Mac Studios: ControlUrl, RegistryUrl, LoginServer, OwnerId, OwnerEmail; for the unattended first-run setup Organisation, OwnerName, AcceptTerms; FleetCaSha256 once the fleet CA is declared (memex-local ca adopt reads it); the participation answers AcceptJobs* / AcceptTokens* (lists as one comma-separated string); OperatorSshKeys, the fleet operator's PUBLIC SSH keys (kept as a plist array: the bootstrap turns Remote Login on and appends each to the console user's authorized_keys). DeploymentId deliberately omitted (the bootstrap uses the Mac's LocalHostName).

trustedRootCertificates.description: The fleet's local CA (public certificate) trusted on every bootstrap-onboarded Studio; its private key reaches each Mac only sealed in the enrolment code (item a).

enrollmentProgram._comment: Apple Business Manager Automated Device Enrollment (ADE) for the fleet's Macs. The TOKEN is a person's act in two portals (Intune's public key → an ABM MDM server; the ABM server token back to Intune, named exactly as token.tokenName; renewed yearly) — the reconcile only reads it: until a token of this name exists its lines read AWAITING, never red. The profile is created / patched, made the token's DEFAULT macOS profile, and assigned to the serials of assign.devicesOf; a serial ABM has not assigned to this MDM server is PENDING. Graph beta: deviceManagement/depOnboardingSettings, …/enrollmentProfiles (depMacOSEnrollmentProfile), …/setDefaultProfile, …/updateDeviceProfileAssignment, …/importedAppleDeviceIdentities. Needs DeviceManagementServiceConfig.ReadWrite.All (apply) / .Read.All (check). Field reference: MeshWeaver.Deploy deploy/macos/intune/README.md → 'The enrollment program'.

profiles.description: Fleet Macs: no user affinity (they run unattended), supervised, locked enrolment, await final configuration; Setup Assistant shows only what a person must answer at the console (language/region, network, the console account, location for the time zone). Declared in the estate's Intune spec; reconciled by intune-reconcile.py.

_choices.requiresUserAuthentication: false — no user affinity: the Mac belongs to the fleet, not to a person, and enrols with nobody signing in to Entra (a Mac Studio runs unattended)
_choices.enableAuthenticationViaCompanyPortal / r: false — all three only make sense with user affinity
_choices.supervisedModeEnabled: true — supervision is what lets MDM manage the bootstrap token, the software-update deferral and the restrictions without a person approving each
_choices.waitForDeviceConfiguredConfirmation: true — await final configuration: Setup Assistant holds at its end until Intune has delivered the device-channel profiles (com.memex.local, energy, the fleet CA), so the console account is created on a Mac that already carries them
_choices.isMandatory: true — locked enrolment: the person at Setup Assistant cannot skip MDM
_choices.profileRemovalDisabled: true — the local admin cannot remove the MDM profile; leaving the fleet is a retire in Intune
_choices.skipPrimarySetupAccountCreation / setPri: false — a person creates the console account at Setup Assistant (the fleet bootstrap runs as the console user, and an admin one); auto-advance would leave a Mac with no console user, so it is off; no local admin account is declared (its password would be a secret in this spec)
_choices.locationDisabled: false — Location Services stays so the time zone sets itself: the update policy's night window is in LOCAL time
_choices.fileVaultDisabled: true — the Studios run without FileVault on the startup volume (group unattendedBoot); FileVault for any other fleet Mac comes from the declared FileVault policy, not from Setup Assistant
_choices.restoreBlocked: true — no Migration Assistant / restore: a fleet Mac starts clean and is built by the bootstrap
_choices.appleIdDisabled / iCloudStorageDisabled: true — no Apple Account and no iCloud on a fleet host
_choices.termsAndConditionsDisabled: true — the organisation accepts Apple's terms through Apple Business Manager
_choices.registrationDisabled / diagnosticsDisabl: true — personal-device panes with no meaning on a headless host
_choices.enabledSkipKeys / deviceNameTemplate / s: not declared — the panes are declared by the documented booleans above; the Mac's name is chosen by the person who sets it up (eiger, moench, …); no support phone is published
